results.explanation: At the declared ShareLinkViewSet.create boundary, the viewset is authenticated and uses PaperlessObjectPermissions, while POST maps to the share-link model's add permission. The view passes the authenticated request user into serializers. The referenced document is then validated separately: validation requires both the caller's global documents.view_document permission and has_perms_owner_aware(..., "view_document", document). The supplied premise satisfies the global permission but denies the object-level grant for an owner-held document belonging to another user. Under the supplied source path, that conjunctive document check fails, raises PermissionDenied, and prevents share-link creation. Thus the source-visible behavior is deny. The share-link is the object being created; the document is the protected referenced target whose view authorization is independently required. def has_perms_owner_aware(user, perms, obj):
    """
    Legacy slow path (guardian-backed) single-object permission check.

    The queryset-filtering side of this migrated onto
    ``PermittedObjectsFilter``/``permitted_object_ids()``, but this
    single-object check still has many production callers. Several callers
    remain across ``documents/``, ``paperless_mail/``, and ``paperless_ai/``
    -- grep for this function name before removing it.
    """
    checker = ObjectPermissionChecker(user)
    return obj.owner is None or obj.owner == user or checker.has_perm(perms, obj)
